title: Stat
description:
A stat shows one value in large digits, its change since the previous refresh and a
sparkline of the last refreshes. The value is the first row of `value_column` (default:
the first numeric column), or `reduce` of all rows. See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

show.title: format, unit, thresholds (notify)
show.description:
`format` is a Python format ("{:,}"), `unit` follows the value. `thresholds` color it
(>= 1000 yellow, >= 1190 red); a step with `notify: true` also notifies once when the
value rises to it.

show.title: thresholds_below, delta_mode: absolute
show.description:
`thresholds_below: true`: lower is worse (free space under 30 yellow, under 10 red).
`delta_mode: absolute` shows the change as an amount, not a percentage.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 10)
SELECT 100 + abs(random() % 50) AS amount FROM n

show.title: reduce: sum, prefix, label
show.label: revenue, last 10 orders

show.title: color_mode: background, sparkline_length
show.description:
`color_mode: background` shows the value reversed, in its color as the background
(Grafana `colorMode`; `none` leaves it plain). `sparkline_length: 40` keeps the last 40
refreshes.

show.title: text_size: normal, delta: false, sparkline: false
show.description:
`text_size: normal` writes the value on one line instead of block digits; `delta:
false` and `sparkline: false` hide the second line.

query.sql:
SELECT 1200 + abs(random() % 300) AS orders, abs(random() % 100) / 100.0 AS conversion,
       40 + abs(random() % 20) AS refunds

show.title: value_columns: several values
show.description:
`value_columns` shows several values side by side (a Grafana stat with several fields),
each a column name or `{ column, label, format, unit, prefix }`. The change and
sparkline follow the first value.
